steps.title: Open lighting controls
steps.body: Open the Lighting panel and inspect directional, ambient, specular, and shadow controls.

success.prompt: Lighting controls are visible or the command is unavailable in this build.

steps.title: Adjust scene readability
steps.body: Use modest lighting changes to make face orientation and shadows clearer. Avoid dramatic settings in technical docs.

steps.title: Learn the capture path
steps.body: For docs authoring, use local MCP to discover screenshot or render-buffer commands before capture.

actions.description: Known from current docs, but authoring scripts must discover capture commands at runtime.

success.prompt: You know that generated screenshots belong in `/images/generated/` with manifest records.
